title: Tight Distinguishing Tradeoffs for 2EM-1 and 2EM-2
summary: Gazi’s generic attack meets the proved distinguishing lower bound for 2EM-1 and 2EM-2 at only one equal-data-and-time point; tight bounds elsewhere remain open.

formal_statement.body: Determine the tight data--time tradeoff for distinguishing attacks on the two-round Even--Mansour constructions 2EM-1 and 2EM-2. Gazi's generic distinguishing attack satisfies $DT^{2}=2^{2n}$, where $D$ and $T$ denote data and time complexities, respectively, but it matches the proved lower bound only at $D=T=2^{2n/3}$. Establish matching upper and lower bounds at every other data--time tradeoff point.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of distinguishing attacks on the two-round Even–Mansour constructions 2EM-1 and 2EM-2.
parameters: n: parameter appearing in the exponents of the stated tradeoff and matching point
scope.unresolved_remainder: Matching upper and lower bounds at every other data–time tradeoff point.
